Parent: #737

## Description

Establish a safe recollection predicate and reuse the engine-held GitHub client. REST not-modified alone is insufficient proof that review-thread/GraphQL-only state is unchanged; specify invalidation or a bounded refresh policy before skipping.

## Evidence and ownership

**Do not recollect a babysit snapshot when the REST probe is unchanged.** [`note_report`](https://github.com/Falconiere/toolu/blob/e829adda0b889830e49d13fe86ff7934f2501ecc/crates/epic-orchestrator/src/github_engine.rs#L99) records `report.fresh` and `report.not_modified`, then calls `babysit::check` whenever the issue phase is `babysit` or `ready`, without consulting those flags. The tick builds [`Client::new`](https://github.com/Falconiere/toolu/blob/e829adda0b889830e49d13fe86ff7934f2501ecc/crates/core/github/src/lib.rs#L121), which calls [`token::resolve`](https://github.com/Falconiere/toolu/blob/e829adda0b889830e49d13fe86ff7934f2501ecc/crates/core/github/src/token.rs#L79) and runs `gh auth token` when `GH_TOKEN` is unset. [`collect`](https://github.com/Falconiere/toolu/blob/e829adda0b889830e49d13fe86ff7934f2501ecc/crates/pr-babysit/src/collect.rs#L76) then reads the head, fans out, and reads the head again. The engine already holds a GitHub client. A skip has to keep time-based reduce timers, the `head_moved` recollect-once behavior, and GraphQL usage accounting. This pass does not prescribe the skip condition.

Source baseline: `6047c50edd68860b775aa1e87d52d1303c70eb93`. Source findings are not runtime proof; reproduce the relevant failure or measure the baseline before claiming a fix or speedup.

## Priority and dependencies

3 — Measured performance.

None; can be delivered independently within the priority order.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document and implement conditions for full collect, cached reduction, timers, and forced refresh; account for GraphQL-only changes rather than assuming REST ETags cover them.
- [ ] An unchanged probe with reusable evidence and no due timer avoids redundant collect; time-based reducer transitions still run when due.
- [ ] Reuse the engine GitHub client/credentials instead of spawning gh auth token every tick, retaining credential refresh and budget behavior.
- [ ] Preserve head_moved recollect-once semantics, GraphQL accounting/rate limits, operator freshness, and merge safety; benchmark request/subprocess reduction.

## Test scenarios

1. Serve repeated REST 304s with unchanged evidence and no timer: request counts show skipped full collection and no repeated gh auth token process.
2. Keep REST unchanged while altering only review threads/GraphQL state: documented invalidation/refresh detects it within its bound and cannot silently authorize an unsafe merge.
3. Expire a reducer timer under REST 304 and test fresh/changed/forced probes: transitions and recollection happen as specified.
4. Move head during collection: recollect once; exercise GraphQL limits/accounting and token refresh. Extend github_engine_babysit_test.rs and github_engine_metrics_test.rs.

## Verification and scope boundaries

- Implementation uses native Rust and the real binary, Git, ast-grep, subprocesses, and local HTTP/Unix servers as appropriate. Use isolated temporary repositories/config roots and existing shared fixtures; no mocking crates or ignored tests.
- Add focused regression coverage in the owning crate and run its tests plus `cargo xtask gate` before pushing an implementation. Record actual commands/results; do not replace verification with a Jev judgment or suppress gate failures.
- For performance/resource work, attach reproducible before/after release-build results with workload, platform, sample count, and relevant request/scan/parse/allocation/thread/fd counts. Do not invent speedup targets from this source audit.
- Preserve public behavior except deliberate documented idempotency/status contract changes. Follow CLI compatibility and generated-document checks if those surfaces change.
- This issue was created as specification only. No implementation, fault injection, benchmarks, or heap profiling were executed while writing it.
title: perf(epic): skip redundant babysit collection with a safe freshness contract
